Name: FasterRun
Author: MimisMods
Description:
I wanted a run speed mod but the ones i've seen either have bugs in them or require you to get the entire game breaking system.
So I made a simple mod that changes your run speed.

Installation:
1. Extract folder to Stardew Valley's root directory.
2. Merge all folders and replace all files (if updating).
4. Navigate to Mods/FasterRun/FasterRun.ini and change the runSpeed to your desired speed (default run speed is 5).
5. Play!

REQUIRES SMAPI:
[url=https://github.com/ClxS/SMAPI/releases]https://github.com/ClxS/SMAPI/releases[/url]
